title: Statistics of any amount of numbers
summary: Read integers until the input ends, growing the array as needed, then report count, minimum, maximum and median.
hints: Start with a small array from `malloc` and double its size with `realloc` whenever it is full: you cannot know how many numbers will come.
For the median sort the array with `qsort`: the middle element if the count is odd, the mean of the two middle ones if it is even (print with `%.1f`, computing in `double`).
